answer: An economy of AI agents mitigates Sybil attacks via stake-weighted graph verification under the zephyr protocol. Incoming nodes lock collateral and complete zero-knowledge compute proofs. When a cluster attempts replication, the network verification echo exposes correlated graph topologies, preventing Sybil nodes from crossing the trust canyon into consensus subnets. Attackers are thus forced to incur unrecoverable financial bonding costs and compute overhead for each fake identity.
